dispatch_rule: Dispatch artifacts may contain the six verified public-domain passage bodies for human review, but those raw passage bodies remain transient workflow artifacts and are not durable repository evidence. Dispatch must contain no model predictions and no human gold.
purpose: Make the human-return boundary mechanically checkable while preserving independent review, exact source custody, disagreement, ambiguity, and model-gold isolation.

review_blinding.reason: Independent structural gold must not be biased by Candidate-002 output or by prior reviewer labels.

completed_packet_shape.source_sha256: exact passage_sha256 from SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A hosted closure
completed_packet_shape.passage_char_length: positive integer measured on UTF-8 strict decode of exact passage bytes with no normalization
completed_packet_shape.passage_locator: stable source locator bound to the same passage digest
completed_packet_shape.task: one of the nine Candidate-002 extraction task families

adjudicators.adjudicator_id: stable reviewer pseudonym or reviewer id
adjudicators.independent_review_digest: sha256 digest of that reviewer's immutable blind review record

forbidden_labels: canonical source-bound label known to be contradicted by source evidence
completed_packet_shape.adjudication_notes_digest: sha256 digest of evaluator-only adjudication notes; notes themselves remain outside model input

source_binding_rules: packet selection_case_id, work_id and task must exist in the frozen six-case SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A closure matrix
source_sha256 must exactly equal the passage_sha256 bound by SOURCE-HELDOUT-002A
source-bound label offsets use Unicode code-point indices in the exact UTF-8 strict decoded passage with no normalization
every gold and forbidden label must validate against the task-specific ontology and passage_char_length
passage replacement remains forbidden except for documented source defect, rights defect or adjudication impossibility
completion_rules: All 18 expected case-task packets must be present exactly once.
Every packet must satisfy the minimum independent-review count for its task.
Every adjudicator review must assert blind review from model predictions and from other reviewer labels.
Gold and forbidden labels must be canonical source-bound ontology labels.
If intentionally_ambiguous is true, at least one gold label must use ALTERNATIVE or UNRESOLVED status unless the packet is a task-scoped ABSTAIN case.
adjudication_notes_digest must be a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest.
No packet completion grants canonical narrative-state, manuscript mutation, author-intent, publication or promotion authority.
post_human_resume: After all returned packets pass the executable validator, freeze one real learned/model backend prediction set against the exact passage digests with gold hidden; only then expose human gold to the scorer.
